messages.content: Add a document checklist feature to this Express app: 1) a GET /api/checklist?scheme=<id> endpoint returning the required documents for that scheme from schemes.json - add a documents array to each scheme entry if missing, but do NOT invent scheme-specific facts: use a conservative generic KYC document set (identity proof, address proof, photo, bank account) unless schemes.json already lists documents; 2) a small section in the public UI letting a user pick a scheme and see its checklist. Keep the existing style, add no dependencies, change no existing scheme facts or amounts. Verify the server still starts with node --check server.js or a quick boot test. Show me a diff summary when done.

Small task: add a GET /api/checklist endpoint to server.js that takes a scheme id query param, reads schemes.json, and returns the required documents for that scheme. If a scheme lacks a documents field, return a generic KYC set: identity proof, address proof, passport photo, bank account details. Change nothing else, add no dependencies.
I'll help you add the GET /api/checklist endpoint. Let me first examine the current server and schemes structure.
